description: manni docs meta/ci/index, run locally in a repo whose manni.config.yaml declares collections pages and guides.

steps.description: The standalone workflow's command: validate all Markdown with --format github. A clean run exits 0.
Let the config file supply the paths: no positional targets reads collections: from manni.config.yaml.
Gate one part of the docs set by naming its collection.
Verify it works: introduce a Markdown file missing the required type field.

runShell.command:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('docs/new-page.md','---
title: New page
description: A page without a type.
---

# New page
')"

steps.description: Locally, --format github prints the raw ::error line for the failing file, and the gate fails.
Drop the flag for the readable pretty report.
